propositions: transport.py chronically forces rescue splits when it exceeds 800-LOC cap; prior reactive splits along arbitrary seams did not change where new code lands, so the file re-grows to cap on each new feature

the natural boundaries exist as Protocols in _backend.py (TicketTransport, SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsAbsenceProbe); aligning module organization to capability seams gives every future operation a determined home

transport.py is split into five capability-aligned mixins (_base, _issues, _hierarchy, _links, _people) composed by a thin transport root; the class remains single and Protocol-conformant so all call sites and tests work unedited
all resulting modules are 100-500 LOC (per policy floor), no test assertions are edited, and _resolve_epic_link_field_id has exactly one definition to avoid reintroducing pre-9bb9 duplication
transport.py is reduced from 799 to 230 LOC, freeing cap headroom for future parent-related work as operator-approved
the split landed before further parent work; infrastructure regression in pagination structural guard vacuity is tracked separately as a consequence of the relocation
